_comment: Test suites deliberately not run by any merge-gate job (#942).
Every entry needs a reason and an OPEN issue: an entry whose issue has closed is itself a violation,
which is what stops this list becoming permanent. Same discipline as scripts/lint-test-suppressions.py.
A project with no test methods is not a suite and does not belong here — the checker classifies it out.
Empty since Subscriptions v1 was deleted: the sole entry was test/Typhon.Client.Tests, which covered the v1
reference client. Both went together, so the exemption has nothing left to exempt. v2's SDK suite arrives with
the subscriptions-sdk job that gates it, not ahead of it.
